claim_text: Yesh Atid's petition to the Central Elections Committee had the meaning/effect of closing Channel 14, and the sitting prime minister was seeking to close a critical media outlet.
discovery_sources: Israel Hayom exact Channel 14 clip; Yesh Atid petition PDF; Channel 14 response brief; election-law text
resolution_notes: Not suitable for an adverse fact-check verdict. The petition expressly sought to designate Channel 14 as an active election body and enjoin continued violations; Channel 14's legal response argued that because a commercial broadcaster could not register under that regime, acceptance could place its continued operation in legal jeopardy. The closure characterization is an advocacy/legal interpretation, not a cleanly false factual claim. Preserve without adverse verdict.
media_status: Exact Channel 14 clip is embedded by Israel Hayom; no publishing needed for rejected candidate.
